name: Beautiful UI
summary: Copy-paste React primitives for AI-native interfaces — thinking, streaming, approvals, tools.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 20 gallery primitives (+ internal atoms) — not full inventory.
Sidebar Nav depends on commercial @central-icons-react — excluded from this batch.
Demos are single-page gallery anchors (#slug) on beautifului.dev — not per-route docs.
Foundation CSS (globals tokens) required once via /r/foundation.json.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Loading State
components.summary: Pixel-grid loader with shimmer and elapsed time.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://www.beautifului.dev/r/loading-state.json

# One-time: also add foundation
# npx shadcn@latest add https://www.beautifului.dev/r/foundation.json
# Import the primitive from the path the CLI writes (components/primitives/...).

copyPrompt.text: Use Beautiful UI free MIT component `Loading State` (slug `loading-state`) from https://www.beautifului.dev/#loading-state. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://www.beautifului.dev/r/loading-state.json` (pulls registryDependencies including foundation). Registry index: https://www.beautifului.dev/r/registry.json. Repo: https://github.com/slev12397/beautiful-ui. Requires React/Next + Tailwind v4 design tokens from foundation. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/slev12397/beautiful-ui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Shane Levine). Pricing free. Also https://www.beautifului.dev/license.
